phase_reuse: One deterministic observation-only phase fit per scene/SNR shared by all four algorithms; equivalence to public receivers checked in preflight.
storage: Save all 3-field public inputs, phase fits, one truth per scene, per-user errors/decisions/scores/noise histories and complete compressed records. Save complete native arrays for scene0000 only (24 outputs), fixed before sampling. Other full estimates can be regenerated using frozen code and input identities.
failure_policy: Record every attempted condition and numerical failure; count budget-stopped finite outputs. Do not replace failed scenes or alter settings using panel results. Report missing/failed counts.
resume: Use atomically completed metric records; interrupted incomplete methods rerun with same input and identity. Preserve failed attempts.
statistics: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 1000 physical scene indices, jointly resampled across methods and SNR; 2000 bootstrap draws, seed 2026101570100000. Report raw counts and paired complete-scene count.
